_comment: Halden Distribution Ltd. — P9 service catalogue. What IT offers, who may request it, who approves and the target time. Applies to OPS01 GLPI (self-service forms + catalogue) and to business/p09-service-catalogue.md. All values are DESIGNED targets, not measured results. Requesters and approvers are synthetic roles for the fictional company.

services.name: New starter setup
services.description: Create the account, mailbox, groups, drive maps and first-day access for a new employee.
services.target: Ready the business day before the start date

services.name: Leaver / offboarding
services.description: Disable the account, remove access, recover equipment and hand over data.
services.target: Within 1 hour of the HR notification

services.name: Software installation
services.description: Install approved software on a managed device; unapproved titles go to IT for review first.
approval: IT if the title is not on the approved list

services.name: VPN access
services.description: MFA-protected remote access for approved remote or travelling staff.

services.name: Shared folder access
services.description: Read or change access to a departmental share, granted through the AGDLP group model.

services.name: Hardware request
services.description: New or replacement laptop, monitor, dock, headset or printer consumables.

services.name: Incident (something is broken)
services.description: Report a fault via the portal, email or phone; routed by priority per the SLA policy.

services.name: Report a suspicious email or security concern
services.description: Report phishing or a suspected security event; always triaged by L2.
services.request_type: Form / email to the security address
services.target: Acknowledge in 1 hour, triage per the P7 IR plan

services.name: Restore a file or folder
services.description: Self-service restore from Previous Versions where possible; else raise a restore request.
